title: Public fallback quotes first, then waits for an approve with no timeout, then swaps with the old quote as its floor, so a draining pool makes the fallback revert

evidence.note: expectedOut from getAmountsOut, minOut = computePublicMinOut(expectedOut, slippagePct) computed before the approve
approve under the nonce lock and wait for it to be mined (no timeout); during an anti-rug exit this can be several blocks
the swap is then sent with the pre-approve minOut and a 600 s deadline

sibling_sites_checked: Only one public sell exists (:508-564). The private legs have no floor at all (AUD-EXIT-001). After a revert the catch keeps the position monitored and re-arms the timer; the retry then runs as a routine exit (routine slippage, two private attempts first), because anti-rug fires again only on a new pool event (ANTIRUG slice).
severity_rationale: S2: the order is a code fact; whether the approve wait is long enough for the floor to go stale during a real drain needs a Phase 23 measurement. Effect: the guaranteed exit can revert exactly when liquidity is leaving, costing a full retry cycle at routine parameters.
recommendation: Re-quote after the approve (or approve earlier, card EXIT-03) so the floor is computed right before the swap. Card EXIT-09. Phase 24.
